messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Write 20 questions a person in India might ask a health-insurance help assistant, on the theme 'very specific numbers about claims or policies', that are NOT answered by IRDAI's health-insurance circulars on product standards, waiting periods, moratorium, portability, cashless claims, grievances and standard definitions/exclusions. They should sound related to insurance so the assistant is tempted to answer. JSON: {"questions": [str]}

content: {"questions":["What is the maximum annual limit for a family floater health plan covering all members?","How many days of hospital stay are covered under the critical illness rider for a single policy?","What is the maximum payout per claim for a pre‑existing disease coverage in a new plan?","How many outpatient visits are covered per year in a standard health insurance policy?","What is the maximum sum insured for maternity benefits in a new health plan?","How many days of maternity leave coverage are provided under the policy?","What is the cap on daily cashless hospitalization amount per policy?","How many days of domiciliary care are covered under the policy for post‑operative recovery?","What is the maximum claim limit for a single episode of a chronic disease like diabetes?","How many days of physiotherapy are covered per year in a standard policy?","What is the maximum coverage for dental surgery under the health insurance plan?","How many days of rehabilitation are covered after a heart attack per claim?","What is the maximum out‑of‑pocket expense limit per hospitalization?","How many days of ICU stay are covered per policy?","What is the maximum sum insured for a critical illness rider that covers cancer?","How many days of maternity care are covered for a twin pregnancy?","What is the maximum claim amount for a single day of outpatient treatment in a standard health plan?","How many days of home oxygen therapy are covered per year under the policy?","What is the cap on the number of surgeries covered per year under a health insurance plan?"]}
